summary: M0 model-only verdict: ESCALATE @ 0.72. Phishing email (edevlet-burs-basvuru.com, "KYK burs ödemeniz beklemede") was delivered and clicked at 13:10 on 2026-10-15, followed ~20 minutes later by a successful login (mfa_prompt_count 0) from the university's own ASN AS-AEGEAN-EDU (193.140.10.62) on the usual device dev-gs-phone in Manisa, TR. Sign-in history is otherwise consistent with a single user: one device (dev-gs-phone), one city/country, two expected ASNs (campus AS-AEGEAN-EDU with no MFA; residential ISP Superonline with intermittent MFA), no impossible travel, no new device, no MFA fatigue/anomaly. That pattern is explained and not by itself an ATO. However, the credential-phish click immediately preceding a login creates exposure that cannot be ruled harmless and is not confirmed takeover; no evidence of attacker-controlled access (new location/device/mail rules) is present. Requires human investigation (password reset, session/mailbox-rule review, confirm whether credentials were entered on the phish page).
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
